entities.summary: Mary Rogers Gregory was a 19th-century American artist from Florida, specializing in portraiture. She painted portraits of Benjamin Harvey Hill, Judge James M. Jackson, Henry W. Grady, Mary Edwards Bryan, Alexander H. Stephens, and Herschel Vespasian Johnson. Several of her paintings were displayed in the art department of the Cotton States and International Exposition.
